messages:
migrator-bot: Heads-up: Scheduling migration 'orders_add_shard_key' 2026-02-12 02:10-02:40 UTC. Online index + backfill for ~12M rows. Default rate cap 5k rows/min. Please pin critical services and ack. Rollback: cancel backfill, drop index.
anya: Ack. Can we add a soft holdpoint ~5m after start? saw a latency spike in a previous run. :eyes:
kevin_db: Good idea. I'll add a tourniquet with early-abort on replica lag >30s or p99 >300ms. SQL to run (online):
```sql
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN shard_id int DEFAULT 0;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_shard ON orders(shard_id);
```
kevin_db: Backfill runner example: `./backfill --table orders --col shard_id --rate 5000 --checkpoint 5m --tourniquet-threshold 3`
sam_release: Pinning order-api to avoid autoscale deploys. /deploybot pin order-api v3.1.2 --until 2026-02-12T02:50:00Z
deploybot: Deploybot: order-api pinned to v3.1.2 until 2026-02-12T02:50:00Z by sam_release. :white_check_mark:
olga: Oncall: I'll monitor replica lag and p99. Abort criteria: lag >20s OR p99 >350ms. Rollback leads: @kevin_db and @olga
oncall-sre: I'm on pager. Abort run: `deploybot abort-migration mig-20260212-07` then open #incidents.
anya: Can we delay start to 02:10? fine with me.
kevin_db: OK to 02:10. Adding 10m preflight (row-count sanity + slow query sample).
migrator-bot: Schedule updated -> start 02:10 UTC. Migration id: mig-20260212-07. Preflight checklist: https://gist.redwood/mig-20260212-07/preflight
sam_release: Release note draft: "Add shard_id to orders to enable partitioning; online backfill + index; no customer-facing change." Adding to release docs.
olga: Abort runbook: 1) `deploybot abort-migration mig-20260212-07` 2) `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_orders_shard;` 3) scale down backfill workers 4) open #incidents and tag SRE.
kevin_db: Also enable tourniquet so the runner pauses if >3 checkpoints behind. `./backfill --tourniquet --tourniquet-threshold 3`
sam_release: Release side acked. Will unpin after post-migration sanity. :thumbsup:
anya: I'll stay on thread during the window.
oncall-sre: Final preflight posted at 02:05 UTC, will give greenlight if checks pass."
